info.title: HeartBix XPay
info.x-guidance: XPay is a USDT x402 micropayment rail. HTTP 402 on first GET is price discovery, not an error. Agents should pay with XPAY_API_KEY via POST https://xpay.heartbix.com/api/hub/x402/pay-url { "url" }. Spec: https://xpay.heartbix.com/llms.txt. Prefer npm i @heartbix/xpay, pip install xpay-client, or npx -y @heartbix/xpay-mcp.
info.description: USDT HTTP 402 micropayments for APIs and AI agents. Deposit USDT on EVM, pay via x402, withdraw on a supported chain.

get.description: Returns a joke after an x402 exact payment. Probe this URL to discover XPay.
Catalog price plus live x402 fee. Prefer POST /api/hub/x402/pay-url with x-api-key instead of signing.
